snippet.title: Untold Secrets: Lost In Time
snippet.description:
Travel the world, uncover clues, interview celebrities and save the world.  Five exciting new hidden object games in one huge bundle.

• 5 Hidden Object Adventures
• Exotic Characters and Locations
• Dramatic Story Plots
• Challenging Mini Games

Time Riddles: The Mansion
Travel back in time to explore a mysterious mansion. Earn bonuses for finding hidden jewels and solving clever riddles as you delve deep into the rich and perplexing history of a uniquely beautiful house.

• A magic game takes you on a time travel adventure 
• Find hidden objects to unravel the mansion's secrets
• Clever mini-games and riddles 

The Lost Kingdom Prophecy
Help Serena stop the dreaded prophecy of the evil wizard Balaak and save the Kingdom of Rosefal from oblivion in this dramatic hidden object adventure.  Lush scenery and colorful characters add to the suspense.

• Thrilling cinematic characters and plot
• Beautifully rendered scenery and locations
• Plus exciting gem matching games

Relic Hunt 
Follow adventurer Marcus Jones to deserted islands, full of danger and excitement, to discover the fantastic treasures left behind.  Solve tricky puzzles to unlock secret locations to find hidden riches.

• Find hidden objects in an exotic tropical setting
• Decipher mysterious maps to unearth treasures
• Explore ancient temples and steamy jungles 
 
My Beautiful Vacation
Jack is a fun-loving teenager who embarks on a fanciful journey to a bird sanctuary, amusement park, a movie studio, a magic tent, an aquarium and more colorful places. Help him find hidden objects and solve puzzles.

• Join Jack on his fantastic hidden object journey 
• Solve perplexing puzzles and riddles
• Relaxing game play with idyllic scenery

Unexpected Journey
Young journalist Lina Woodberry is meeting famous people from the arts and culture world on a lively cruise ship. Join Lina on the celebrity interviews, high-spirited photo shots and glamorous parties.

• Spectacular hidden object locations
• Mini-games, spot the difference and photo shoots
• Relaxed or challenging timed play 

Visit us at www.onhandsoftware.com

SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS: 1.5GHz Pentium Processor or better, Windows®  XP/ Vista / 7,  512MB RAM, DirectX 9 compatible video /sound cards,500MB free hard drive space, CD-ROM, Mouse, 1024x768 screen resolution
